earlierExtraction.observation: The brown rooted bundle at 15:20 agrees with the game captures in outline. The interval is not labelled by species. It corroborates the arrangement only.

limits: Only the visible brown rooted form is illustrated. Framing, exact stalk spacing and simplified floor-contact line are reconstructed. Separate roots, host anatomy, other color forms, behavior and combat are outside the evidence.
